protocol.failed_pilots: Retained; confirmation runs not attempted after failed pilot.
protocol.timing: Fixed-placement route-through-FULL/STA. Offline graph projection reported separately; GPU workflow includes route process, audit, export, VPR FULL/STA.
protocol.process_comparison: Diagnostic only: GPU route process excludes audit/export/FULL/STA; workflow comparison includes them.
protocol.preparation: Offline immutable projection excluded from online timing; preparation_seconds recorded per case.
protocol.search_timing: GPU synchronized host wall time, includes launches/transfers; VPR native path-search timer; not pure kernel equivalence.

variants.delay_proxy: 1 + rounded switch delay in ps; source-rooted shortest-path tree under each congestion snapshot. Not STA criticality-driven.
